in_sanskrit.name: वलय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
वल्यम् (valyam) - strength, power
आ (a) - towards
ि (i) - this
Therefore, Balai means 'towards strength', 'towards power', or 'towards virility' in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.name: बलाई
in_hindi.long_meaning:
बाल (bal) - child, young
आई (ai) - mother
Therefore, Balai can be interpreted as 'child of strength', 'mother of power', or 'mother of tapas (penance)' in Hindi.
